title: EATF AEP v1 mandate.json
description: Validates the optional detached mandate.json entry inside an AEP v1 evidence package (docs/specs/aep-profile-v1.md, section 4.5). A mandate is a once-authored, versioned grant by which a named granting authority authorises a subject agent to act within a stated scope for a stated period. The packaged bytes MUST be the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical form of this object, referenced by authorizing_principal.mandate_digest from metadata.json, and signed by the granting authority's own key in the detached mandate.sig. The granting authority is a named principal with a verifiable key binding under the same self-attestation trust model as public_key.pem; nothing here establishes it as a legally constituted authority, and whether the grant is lawful is attested, never machine-checked.

mandate_id.description: Stable identifier of this mandate. MUST equal metadata.authorizing_principal.mandate_ref.

principal.description: Named identifier of the granting authority — the deontic principal that made the grant. MUST equal metadata.authorizing_principal.principal.

subject.description: Named identifier of the agent the mandate is granted to. MUST equal metadata.agent_id.

granted_at.description: RFC 3339 instant at which the grant was made.

statement.description: Human-readable statement of what the granting authority authorised. Attested, never machine-checked.

scope.description: The action classes and policies the grant covers. An attested action outside this scope is reported and does not by itself fail verification.

valid_from.description: RFC 3339 start of the mandate's validity window, checked against the RFC 3161 genTime.

valid_until.description: RFC 3339 end of the mandate's validity window, checked against the RFC 3161 genTime.

public_key.description: PEM-encoded RSA public key of the granting authority, against which the detached mandate.sig is verified. A principal distinct from the package issuer's public_key.pem and from the accepting authority of sections 4.2-4.3.
